scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @jashn/contracts && npm run build -w @jashn/planning-rules
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @jashn/api && npm run build -w @jashn/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && node --import tsx --test packages/contracts/src/contracts.test.ts apps/api/src/app.test.ts
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others -n contracts,rules,api,web "npm run dev -w @jashn/contracts" "npm run dev -w @jashn/planning-rules" "npm run dev -w @jashn/api" "npm run dev -w @jashn/web"
